# Ghanshyam Ghimire — Personal Portfolio

> Official portfolio of Ghanshyam Ghimire, an AI engineering student at Kathmandu University, Nepal, and a singer-songwriter with four original Nepali songs released. This site presents his AI/ML engineering work, freelance projects, hackathon achievements, technical skills, and his music catalogue.

## About

Ghanshyam Ghimire is a BTech Artificial Intelligence student (Batch 2024–2028) at Kathmandu University, Nepal. He specialises in machine learning, computer vision, OCR systems, and NLP. Alongside engineering, he is a singer-songwriter who writes and releases original Nepali indie pop folk music under his own name. His dual identity — AI engineer by logic, musician by heart — is the central concept of this portfolio.
